answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 42364 Country: Bangladesh Title: My daughter name Question: My daughter name is Nusrat Tasnim Zaara. What is the meaning of it? And as per the Shariah is it right or wrong? Answer ID: 42364 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1110/1111/N=1433) (1 & 2) Nusrat means help. Tasnim is the name of a canal in Jannah. And we do not know the meaning of Zara. Hence only Nursrat Tasnim is lawful and correct name as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
